Gona
of Bengal. father of Nārāyaṇa Upādhyāya (a. of Chāndogyapariśiṣṭaprakāśa, Intro. verses 9, 10).
See IHQ. XXII. p. 137.

Gonanda(na)
poet. eulogised by Rājaśekhara, Smv. p. 46 (no. 85); noted for Anuprāsa. Subhāṣitaratnakośa 87, 672. 1641 (Gotrānanda in Smv.).
See Kvs. Intro. p. 37; Subhāṣitaratnakośa, Intro. lxxvi.

Gonartaka
authority on Kāmaśāstra. ref. to by Kāñcīnātha in his C. on Ratirahasya,

Gonardīya
authority on gr. Q. by Patañjali in Mahābhāṣya under Sūtras

. Probably wrote in Kārikās.
See Ind. Ant.

Gonardīya
authority on Kāmaśāstra. ref. to by Vātsyāyana a. the author of a section on Bhāryādhikāra (Kāmasūtra,
). Q. by Vātsyāyana (ibid. I. i. 15. v. 25. IV. i. 4, 21. ii. 36, 42); by Kāñcīnātha in C. on Ratirahasya,

; by Rājaśekhara, Kāvyamīmām3sā, GOS. I. (1924). p. 26.
See also Sir Asutosh Com. Vol. III. Orientalia

Gonāmika
(Pariśiṣṭa of Maitrāyaṇīyas).
